decisions.reason: The INA219 placement changes current-measurement coverage but does not change DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or its role as the normal 3.3V source.
The three-board architecture and existing main-board role remain valid; the detailed power-chain and INA219 topology belong to the dedicated interboard-power and current-monitoring Requirements.
Placing the INA219 downstream of the Schottky diodes does not alter the standalone USB regulator, its activation condition, source selection, or powered 3.3V rail.
The source clarifies downstream current monitoring and interboard distribution without changing the AXP2101, required rails, or battery power path.
The source decision concerns the INA219 on the 3.3V rail and does not change the independently switched 5V rail or any of its loads and controls.
The cross-Requirement effect is already fully represented by the candidate's existing message 347 MODIFY describing the board chain, connectors, and power forwarding; no addition or edit is required.
Current-monitor placement and downstream measurement coverage do not change ESP32 clock, sleep, deep-sleep, or wake behavior.
The source does not address the battery connector's family, contacts, pin functions, compatibility, or unresolved pin order.
The INA219 topology does not modify battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or other protection requirements.
The source contains no decision about charge-status indication, its connector, resistor, or LED population.
The clarified power path and current-monitor placement do not change the required TVS ESD protection.
The source concerns 3.3V current monitoring and does not change the LEDs' 5V supply, level shifting, shutdown control, or standby-current target.
